messages:
Ravi: Heads up, opened a migration PR to replace deprecated export-redaction examples and add an explicit SDK snippet for client-side pseudonymization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1309

Nora: Thanks. Saw the PR — CI shows a broken curl example and a missing anchor to the residency section (the guide recently renamed that heading).

docs-bot: CI: docs lint failed - markdown link check error at exports.md line 98.

Priya: I'll fix the anchor. For the curl example, what's the minimal safe example we want? We should avoid implying Redwood performs key management for customer salts.

Legal-Bot: From legal review: prefer language that says exports "may include pseudonymized identifiers" and call out that customer-managed keys are required for reversible mappings. Avoid suggesting Redwood retains customer salts.

Ravi: Good call. Proposed sentence: "Exported evidence may contain pseudonymized identifiers derived from keys or salts under customer control; re-identification requires access to those keys." Will add a parenthetical note about KMS/HSM.

Nora: For code, let's show both client-side JS pseudonymization and an SDK snippet using a placeholder getCustomerKey() call. Keep it pseudocode. Example JS:

```js
// client-side pseudonymize (example only)
async function pseudonymize(id) {
  const key = await getCustomerKey(); // placeholder, do NOT call Redwood KMS in examples
  return await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(key + id));
}
```

Priya: Use HMAC in the JS sample rather than concatenation. Also add a short ruby/curl example showing export invocation and a header note.

Ravi: Updated examples pushed. Changed wording to include "pseudonymized" and note KMS. Also fixed the anchor to #data-residency-and-sovereignty. CI triggered.

docs-bot: CI: build failed - broken code fence in exports.md (line 142).

Nora: Oops, my bad—left a triple-backtick mismatch. Fixing now. Also adding a one-line changelog entry under docs/changelog.md >> Security: clarify pseudonymization wording for exports.

Priya: Quick review pass: samples look good, HMAC example uses subtle crypto correctly, and the curl example includes Authorization header but explicitly notes token scopes.

Legal-Bot: ✅ Wording approved. Suggest adding a short FAQ bullet: "Can Redwood re-identify exported pseudonymized IDs?" Answer: "No — re-identification requires access to customer-managed keys/salts; Redwood does not have access unless explicitly configured"

Ravi: Added FAQ bullet and amended export guide to reference key management best practices page. Pushed and CI is green: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8043

docs-bot: CI: build passed on staging. All checks OK.

Nora: :raised_hands: Ready to merge once changelog formatted.

Ravi: Changelog added and PR merged. Thanks team.
